purpose: Operational three-wavelength clear-sky radiance smoke check, not a paper or horizon accuracy benchmark.
geometry: DISORT plane-parallel standard US atmosphere; ground observer, solar zenith 30 degrees, viewing elevation 20 degrees, looking away from the Sun.
quantity: Columns: wavelength and directional spectral sky radiance (lambda, uu).
limitations: No aerosol; default molecular absorption and standard atmospheric profiles.
Black surface; scalar unpolarized DISORT with 16 streams.
This checks invocation and finite positive output only; it does not establish matched inputs, horizon adequacy, convergence or local-source accuracy.
